_readme: Hand-written photo captions, keyed by the filename in static/images/photography. A caption is the title shown in the lightbox, and the alt text only when scripts/photo-alts.json has no description for that photo (that file holds the plain, non-visible descriptions screen readers and AI agents get). Photos with no entry here and no IPTC/XMP Title stay untitled (no title line) rather than falling back to their filename. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Lightroom's Title field (IPTC Object Name) is read automatically on export, so filling that in is equivalent to adding an entry here.
